compliance.status: QUAM — prospective need exempt; rehabilitation-only Fourth Round obligation

notes: Hackensack is a Qualified Urban Aid Municipality (QUAM). Fourth Round obligation is rehabilitation-only: 593 present need, 0 prospective need. The HEFSP documents 116-unit surplus from the Prior Round credited toward the 593-unit rehab obligation. New construction sites documented in the plan satisfy prospective need from prior rounds and carry bonuses/credits; six distinct sites with block/lot data are captured below. The city has an adopted Affordable Housing Overlay/Distressed Facilities Overlay ordinance (Ord 04-2026) for downtown Fourth Round zones; that ordinance was fetched but not in scope for additional sites beyond what the HEFSP describes.
